'''Bill Prather''' (also published as '''Will Prather''') is a Star Wars CCG player from the Colorado Springs area who finished 1st at [[August 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (11 August)]] on 11 August 2001, according to Patrick Napier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2848">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-16-colorado-springs-a-dark-comeback-8-11-01d2848/ colorado-springs-a-dark-comeback-8-11-01], DeckTech (Patrick "Pappy" Napier, 16 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-16-colorado-springs-a-dark-comeback-8-11-01d2848/ GitHub Pages].</ref> As Will Prather (rated 1656) he played [[October 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (6 October)]] on 6 October 2001 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltir Ops]], according to Danny Hummel's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3060">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-16-nexis-colorado-springs-10-6-hb-sucksd3060/ nexis-colorado-springs-10-6-hb-sucks], DeckTech (Dan "Nexis" Hummel, 16 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-16-nexis-colorado-springs-10-6-hb-sucksd3060/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
